It is noteworthy that acomputerized mariage registration certificate of the petitioner's parents was available on the file' According to the said document, the marriage of the petitioner's parents was solemnized on09-10-1991. If this document is taken into consideration, the recording of the petitioner's date of birth as 15-07-1990 in the NADRA record becomes factually impossible and unnatural, as it precedes the marriage of her parents. This glaring contradiction strikes at the very credibility of the NADRA enry regarding the petitioner's date of birth' Sigrrificantly, the aforesaid marriage registation certificate was neither objected by the respondents through any written document nor the same was challenged or during the course of arguments by the learned Law Offtcer NADRA. In the absence of any rebuttal, the said document canies strong probative value and conclusively establishes that the petitioner could not have been bom prior to the marriage of her parents. In view of the above discussion, this Court is of the considered opinion that both the learned Courts below misread and non-read the material evidence, particularly the marriage registration certificate of the petitioner's parents, resulting in miscaniage of justice.
